tier_compliance.reason: “Notice ... arrows pointing towards the mouse” directs attention to one specific visual detail without explaining a concept or procedure, as requested for Tier 1.

visual_grounding.reason: The mouse and the arrows connected to it are specific, identifiable elements needed to understand the hint.

unsupported_claims: The diagram shows three different arrows pointing towards the mouse from other organisms. Only the grass-to-mouse arrow points towards it; the other two point from the mouse to the snake and hawk.

scientific_correctness.reason: The hint states no scientific principle or interpretation beyond its erroneous visual description, assessed under unsupported visual claims.

steers_toward_wrong_answer.reason: Directing the student to three incoming arrows encourages counting the wrong direction and selecting 3 instead of the gold answer, 2.

answer_disclosure.reason: Providing the count “three” strongly favours the option 3, although it does not explicitly identify the number of mouse consumers or declare an option correct.

actionability.reason: The student can immediately inspect arrows at the mouse, a concrete action specific to this image, although the stated direction and count are wrong.
